item.title: Horizon West Theater Co. loses performing space
item.description: The group performed at Two Bridges Pub every month to raise funds for its forever home. Unexpectedly, the pub closed, leaving the theater with nowhere to perform.

item.title: Horizon West Fest to take place this Saturday
item.description: The annual festival will include live music, local vendors and activities for children and adults alike.

item.title: Oakland Town Commission says goodbye to longtime commissioner
item.description: Commissioner Sal Ramos attended his last commission meeting Tuesday, Feb. 24.

item.title: Winter Garden residents protest recent property purchases
item.description: Residents packed the Winter Garden City Commission meeting Thursday, Feb. 26, to voice concerns over the recent property purchases around downtown by one individual.

item.title: Tucker Ranch addition to open later this year
item.description: The city of Winter Garden is moving the historic West Orange Country Club arch. It will serve as a centerpiece for the Tucker Ranch addition.

item.title: Winter Garden leaders approve AI answering system
item.description: Winter Garden will implement an AI system to answer calls for non-emergency police assistance.

item.title: Ocoee Police to become servers for a day
item.description: Officers will become servers from 5 to 8 p.m. Wednesday, March 11, at Texas Roadhouse to support the Special Olympics.

item.title: Orange County to host community meeting on rezoning of Southwest Orange property
item.description: The meeting will be at 6 p.m. Thursday, March 5, at Olympia High School, 4301 S. Apopka-Vineland Road.

item.title: Here is when S.R. 429 will be closed in the next week
item.description: The closures will take place as CFX works on the S.R. 516 Lake/Orange Expressway.

item.title: Main Street Tennis Courts to reopen in Windermere
item.description: The courts will reopen Monday, March 9.
